name: New York Supreme Cheesecake  | Mini Eclair  | HYMAN
description:
Twice infused. Twice enjoyed. Each Éclair blends premium flower (0.6g) with cold-cured, hash rosin (0.1g), then finishes strong with a glass tip and H₂O brushing for a smooth, even burn. Built to taste better and burn smarter. — all for the perfect HY. 
GET BAKED TWICE 💨 
Strain Type: Hybrid 
Flavors: Sweet, Citrus, Grapefruit 
Aromas: Pungent, Diesel, Strawberry 
Experience: Sociable, Happy, Creative
